facts.fact: The Resin House cook-house door is barred from inside once the long table has eaten; the east side of the compound is described only by wall and drain counts.
facts.why: needed because the raid plan on the tally board needs a third exit detail; Neela supplies it from memory.

facts.fact: Bhaskaran's men who carried water to the Resin House kennels reported 'forty-odd' iron cages in a row with a door at each end; Neela confirms forty-one.
facts.why: needed because Bhaskaran draws the kennels roof from his men's account (consistent with F264, F235).

facts.fact: Neela scrapes her left shin on the scree in shape; a thin welt matching it shows on Devan's left shin, and he feels two sharp stings around the middle watch.
facts.why: needed because the wound-share is how Devan follows her night scouting without seeing it.

facts.fact: Neela's scouting reading: Rema's escort went down the goat path toward the lightning boulder and cart road, but the trail was lost on the scree in three days of rain; something heavier than a leopard went up the scree toward the shoulder the same night, leaving a long drag in fresh gravel.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires her dawn report; the heavy animal is left unnamed.

facts.fact: Rema says Muthu has not missed a month in six years of letters to the queen's household; Devan realises six years matches the winter Asha died and that his captain's 'letters to his mother' were a lie.
facts.why: needed because the supper beat names the letters before the hall and sets up chapter 9's confession.
